text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Oh man... I can't blow this bubblegum 
properly.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Even after chewing extra gum, it doesn't 
feel like it's going to blow a bubble at 
all...
choice_data_list: Are you feeling off, by any chance?

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Mmm, true, people tend to make a lot of 
careless mistakes at times like this.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Actually, things might be in the danger 
zone...?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Bubble Gum Fellow might still be feeling 
the fatigue from the race. It would be 
best to review her schedule.
